_comment: Hand names for 05007038 (family C; also used for 05293148AA, same code), read from the code. tools/port.py lays them over the names carried over from 05293190AC.

Options0331.4: development port on: external 16 KB device on chip select 1 at $20000, probably the dual-port RAM of a calibration tool (DevPortInit, DevPortService, DevPortChannel1-8; FinishFuelPulse, StartInjectorPulse and SparkEventCalc write per-event values to it); clear in 05007038 and 05293148AA
